Issue Number: close #52140

see description in issue

### What changed and how does it work?

### Check List

- Add a new struct `assertionEvalContext` which implements `EvalContext`. It is only used in tests and hooks the method `GetOptionalPropProvider`. Once it finds a function is reading an optional property but not declared it in `RequiredOptionalEvalProps`, the test will fail.
- Modify some test cases and use `evalBuiltinFunc` or `vecEvalType` to evaluate expressions to make sure the context is wrapped in tests.

issue_context.title: Check some constraints when evaluating a expression to make code strong
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

Currently, there are some constraints we need to follow when coding with expressions. For if a `builtinFunc` uses an optional property when evaluating, it should declare it in the method `RequiredOptionalEvalProps`. To make sure the coder does not forget to declaring corresponding property key, we should add some asserts in test.

review_comments: This is a mistake in the previous PR but was found after assertions were added.
